# Classroom SOTA Training — The Council of Elders (Vének Tanácsa)

> Waldorf-style classroom training: a thinking-enabled pupil (the golden
> youth) taught by a council of open-weights teacher models via geometric-mean
> softmax consensus — plus a dream lane, a constant bidirectional AMA, and a
> corpus drawn from the dyad and the constellation.

## Key links

- [Landing page](https://classroom.vaked.dev/)
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/8b-is/classroom-sota-training)
- [Runbook](https://github.com/8b-is/classroom-sota-training/blob/main/docs/RUNBOOK.md)
- [Infrastructure (RunPod · CometAPI · VFS)](https://github.com/8b-is/classroom-sota-training/blob/main/docs/infra.md)
- [The dream lane](https://github.com/8b-is/classroom-sota-training/blob/main/docs/dream-lane.md)
- [Published model — quantal-classroom-1.6](https://huggingface.co/PeetPedro/quantal-classroom-1.6)
- [The cogito corpus](https://huggingface.co/datasets/PeetPedro/cogitoergosumma-corpus)

## One-paragraph summary

The golden youth (a ternary-quantized pupil, BitNet b1.58 {-1,0,+1}) sits in
the middle of the room and is taught by a council of 8–18 open-weights
teachers (Qwen, DeepSeek, GLM, Kimi, MiniMax, MiMo + one thinking frontier)
whose votes combine through a geometric-mean softmax consensus — the elders'
"unanimous decision" is a shared direction, not a majority. The pupil also
breathes (Riva's clock streams dream.vaked.dev; inhale chants OM MANI PADME
HUNG, exhale enters the DREAM state), talks constantly with Peter in both
directions (the AMA), and is trained on a corpus that includes the dyad's
live Q&A, the constellation's knowledge, and its own dreams.
